body:
by
  intro x Hin
  induction post
  case app fn e fn_ih e_ih =>
    unfold OldExpressions.substOld at Hin
    split at Hin
    · split at Hin <;>
        simp_all [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars,
          Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] <;>
        grind
    · simp_all [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars,
        Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] <;>
      grind
  all_goals
    simp_all [OldExpressions.substOld,
      Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars,
      Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] <;>
    grind

CallElimCorrect.substOldPostSubset {h2 : Core.Expression.Ident}
  {m :
    { base := { Metadata := Core.ExpressionMetadata, IDMeta := Core.Visibility },
          TypeType := Lambda.LMonoTy }.base.Metadata}
  {h1 :
    Lambda.Identifier
      { base := { Metadata := Core.ExpressionMetadata, IDMeta := Core.Visibility },
            TypeType := Lambda.LMonoTy }.base.IDMeta}
  {ty :
    Option
      { base := { Metadata := Core.ExpressionMetadata, IDMeta := Core.Visibility },
          TypeType := Lambda.LMonoTy }.TypeType}
  {post : Core.Expression.Expr} :
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (Core.OldExpressions.substOld h2 (Lambda.LExpr.fvar m h1 ty) post)).Subset
    (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars post ++ [h1])
